motion.name: scroll-scrub
motion.value: passive scroll + requestAnimationFrame; 45% dwell then 48% smoothstep interpolation
motion.purpose: Give each chapter reading time before the object transforms toward the next pose.

motion.name: pose-rebuild
motion.value: CSS3D translate3d/rotate/scale interpolation across twelve fragments and seven scenes
motion.purpose: Reassemble one shared object into identity, architecture, cross-client, memory, taste, and team explanations.

motion.name: scene-state
motion.value: interpolated stage background, camera angle, fragment opacity, overlays, and chapter dots
motion.purpose: Keep the visual stage synchronized with the readable chapter.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; transitions, animations, and smooth scrolling disabled
motion.purpose: Keep the document and static diagrams readable while removing motion.

motion.name: short-viewport
motion.purpose: Avoid making the sticky spatial stage compete with copy in short windows.

motion.name: scroll-cue
motion.value: 2.4s ease-in-out opacity pulse and 6px vertical travel in enhanced mode only
motion.purpose: Suggest scrolling with one familiar icon; no written instructions.

breakpoints.name: wide

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Reduce scene scale to 0.88 and tighten navigation and copy proportions.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Use a 64px header, 24px gutter, lower stage object, full-width copy, and bottom chapter dots.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Reduce the spatial object scale for the smallest supported width.

breakpoints.name: short-viewport
breakpoints.purpose: Use the static reading layout without enhanced choreography.

narrative.overview:
The public site is a Chinese, Apple-like spatial product narrative. Large restrained typography gives the promise room to land while one physical-looking object carries the explanation. Twelve reusable CSS3D fragments begin scattered, then assemble and recompose as the visitor scrolls. The same object models identity, architecture, client continuity, memory, taste, and team coordination.

The page uses native document scrolling and progressive enhancement. HTML chapters, static diagrams, manifesto, setup, questions, and footer remain the reading surface. JavaScript adds a sticky full-viewport stage, scroll-scrubbed transforms and overlays when motion is appropriate. The public page is scoped to site/.
keyCharacteristics: Porcelain paper, carbon black, silver, and jade create a quiet physical palette.
One twelve-piece object moves through seven authored poses.
Large restrained Chinese headlines leave space around the spatial object.
CSS perspective, six-sided fragments, inset highlights, and one ground shadow provide depth.
Architecture is explicit: adapter connectors, Fuli orchestration, Python Provider, and Neo4j storage.
Static, reduced-motion, short-viewport, and no-JavaScript paths keep the story available.

rules.name: The Shared Object Rule
rules.body: Every narrative pose keeps the same twelve fragments; arrangement, labels, opacity, and camera angle change.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep large Latin identity in Unbounded and let the system sans stack carry Chinese product communication.

rules.name: The Material-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Use the established fragment materials, perspective, atmosphere, and ground shadow for spatial depth.

dos: Do keep the system scoped to the public site/ surface and describe values that exist in its source.
Do use large restrained Chinese type with generous empty space around the spatial object.
Do keep the same twelve fragments across all seven poses.
Do retain static diagrams, saved visible records with budgeted context restoration, source/scope/confirmation language, and local setup instructions.
Do preserve native scrolling, reduced-motion behavior, short-viewport fallback, and no-JavaScript readability.
Do keep fictional examples labeled and publish only public product facts.
donts: Don't replace the spatial object with a node-and-path diagram or flat panel grid.
Don't replace the spatial object with repeated feature cards, synthetic activity, or private project evidence.
Don't imply that every client has a native @Agent menu, captures complete transcripts, or supports an unavailable adapter.
Don't describe the seven-day window as deletion or claim that a team server package is already released.
Don't add decorative gradients, blur, or elevation outside the established stage material language.
